integrity: The theorem is proved self-containedly. The bundled finite checker is supplementary rather than a substitute for the proof. The originality claim is limited to the sharp quantitative actual-effectivity realization bound and its application, not to the general combinatorial idea of slice-surjective arrays.
scientific_limitations: Finite and local only. The lower bound is worst-case rather than an exact per-frame minimum; for two agents there is no exponent gain; no bound on formula-model size or decision complexity is claimed.
title: Sharp root-size action realization for finite actual-effectivity frames
